paper.title: Dynamic Cheatsheet: Test-Time Learning with Adaptive Memory
paper.central_claim: DC以自策展、持久化的策略/代码记忆，在无真值反馈、无权重更新的测试流中提升黑盒模型推理表现并减少重复错误。

provenance.notes: 按派发会话 gpt-6.1-sol 执行；没有可独立绑定的实际模型回执/session记录，依模板置null，不额外探测。

sections_read: Appendix B.1–B.4.3（图为图注，未臆造图内提示词）

evidence.quote: does not have access to ground-truth labels; so, it has to assess the correctness and efficiency of the solutions by itself before updating the memory.
evidence.support_explanation: 自判而非真实标签控制记忆写入。

evidence.quote: refinement or removal of existing memory entries
evidence.support_explanation: 更新或删除旧记忆；不是仅追加原始轨迹。

evidence.quote:
We set
k
k
to 3 in all our experiments.
evidence.support_explanation: 检索过去三个相似问题及其生成答案，再策展、生成。

evidence.quote: To isolate the effect of memory curation, this DC baseline always keeps the memory content effectively empty.
evidence.support_explanation: 空记忆保留结构化生成器提示词。
19%空记忆与99% DC-RS比较支持记忆作用，但不是成本匹配的全部归因。

evidence.quote: Claude 3.5 Sonnet improved from 59.6% to 68.7% under DC-RS
evidence.support_explanation: 知识任务也有收益；不是所有模型均有收益。

evidence.quote: Such truncated memory updates can reduce the quality of stored heuristics over time.
evidence.support_explanation: 作者报告整份记忆重写造成截断，维护并不完全可靠。

evidence.quote: On AIME 2024, Claude Sonnet averaged 370 tokens under BL, 494 under DC-
evidence.support_explanation: 报告了部分token成本；不能当完整策展加检索成本。

evidence.quote: takes a slightly different approach by distilling high-level “thought templates” from problem-solving processes, though it relies on predefined templates
evidence.support_explanation: BoT是作者指出的近邻；尚无该近邻独立全文。

evidence.quote: indicates a new query or problem posed to the model sampled from the same distribution
evidence.support_explanation: 按顺序处理未见输入，在线测试流本身更新记忆；不是冻结后独立任务族测试。
AIME每个年度30题；没有重复次序不确定性。

evidence.quote: GPT-4o, on the other hand, observed slight decreases from the baseline on these tasks
evidence.support_explanation: 明确包含失败边界，不支持统一提升主张。

signatures.object: 历史问题-生成答案案例库（DC-RS）

gap.author_gap: 独立推理反复发现相同策略；静态RAG不能累计可推广的推理经验。
